entries.title: Psalms 17:1
segments: <<A Prayer of David.>> Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

entries.title: Psalms 17:2
segments: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.

entries.title: Psalms 17:3
segments: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

entries.title: Psalms 17:4
segments: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.

entries.title: Psalms 17:5
segments: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.

entries.title: Psalms 17:6
segments: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, [and] hear my speech.

entries.title: Psalms 17:7
segments: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge [in thee ]From those that rise up [against them].

entries.title: Psalms 17:8
segments: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

entries.title: Psalms 17:9
segments: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.

entries.title: Psalms 17:10
segments: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.

entries.title: Psalms 17:11
segments: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast [us] down to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 17:12
segments: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
segments: Arise, O Jehovah,  Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;

entries.title: Psalms 17:14
segments: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in [this] life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

entries.title: Psalms 17:15
segments: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with [beholding] thy form.
